title: Soulflow (Mechanic)

{{DISPLAYTITLE:Soulflow}} {{For|the item which grants {{Stat|soulflow|160}} when consumed|Soulflow (Item)}} {{Infobox/Stat |image=Soulflow (currency).png |uses = Abilities of some items, {{Stat|Overflow Mana}} Conversion |ways_to_increase = Consuming Soulflow Items: {{Item|Soulflow (Item)|text=Soulflow}}/{{Item|Raw Soulflow}} |symbol = ⸎ |unicode = U+2E0E }} {{Stat|Soulflow}}, or '''Internalized Soulflow''', is a player resource similar to {{Stat|mana}}. It is used to fuel powerful abilities from the [[Enderman Slayer]] and to generate {{Stat|overflow mana}}. == Obtaining == A player can obtain {{Stat|Soulflow}} by consuming the following Soulflow Items: {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Item ! {{Stat|Soulflow}} Granted |- | {{Slot|Raw Soulflow}} | [[Raw Soulflow]] | 1 |- | {{Slot|Soulflow}} | [[Soulflow (Item)|Soulflow]] | 160 |} A minion will start producing Soulflow Items when equipped with the following Minion Upgrades: {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Item ! Remarks |- | {{Slot|Lesser Soulflow Engine}} | [[Lesser Soulflow Engine]] | Produces {{Red|50% less}}
Produces {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} (Also {{Item|Soulflow (Item)|text=Soulflow}} with {{Item|Super Compactor 3000}}/{{Item|Dwarven Super Compactor}}) |- | {{Slot|Soulflow Engine}} | [[Soulflow Engine]] | Produces {{Red|50% less}}
Produces {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} (Also {{Item|Soulflow (Item)|text=Soulflow}} with {{Item|Super Compactor 3000}}/{{Item|Dwarven Super Compactor}})
{{Green|+3%}} output when used on a {{MinionName|Voidling}} |} By consuming Soulflow Items, a player receives an amount of '''Internalized Soulflow''', which is also signified by the icon [[File:Soulflow (currency).png|13px|link=]]. Once consumed, there is no way to turn the {{Stat|Soulflow}} back into items. There is no known cap for the amount of Internalized {{Stat|Soulflow}} a player can have at once. == Usage == Internalized {{Stat|Soulflow}} is not displayed on the action bar, and can only be viewed on the tooltip of [[Soulflow Pile]] line accessories or in the Profile widget in the [[Tablist Widgets]]. Certain powerful abilities and items use {{Stat|soulflow}}: {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Item ! {{Stat|Soulflow}} Cost |- | {{Slot|Handy Blood Chalice}} | [[Handy Blood Chalice]] | 1 per 5s in combat |- | {{Slot|Pocket Espresso Machine}} | [[Pocket Espresso Machine]] | 1 per 5s in combat |- | {{Slot|Soulflow Pile}} | [[Soulflow Pile]] | Up to 5 when leaving combat |- | {{Slot|Soulflow Battery}} | [[Soulflow Battery]] | Up to 4 when leaving combat |- | {{Slot|Soulflow Supercell}} | [[Soulflow Supercell]] | Up to 4 when leaving combat |- | {{Slot|Etherwarp Conduit}} | [[Etherwarp Conduit]] | 1 |- | {{Slot|Voidedge Katana}} | [[Voidedge Katana]] | 1 |- | {{Slot|Vorpal Katana}} | [[Vorpal Katana]] | 1 |- | {{Slot|Atomsplit Katana}} | [[Atomsplit Katana]] | 2 |- | {{Slot|Final Destination Chestplate}} | [[Final Destination Armor]] | 2 per 5s in combat |- | {{Slot|Gloomlock Grimoire}} | [[Gloomlock Grimoire]] | 15 |- | {{Slot|Gyrokinetic Wand}} | [[Gyrokinetic Wand]] | 10 (Left Click) |- | {{Slot|Gyrokinetic Wand}} | [[Gyrokinetic Wand]] | 2 (Right Click) |- | {{Slot|Soul Esoward}} | [[Soul Esoward]] | 10 |- | {{Slot|Terminator}} | [[Terminator]] | 1 |} If insufficient {{Stat|soulflow}} is available, the abilities will not work. == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" ! Condition ! Game Message |- | class="ct" rowspan="2" | Attempting to use an ability
without sufficient {{Stat|soulflow}} | {{Dialogue|&cNot enough soulflow!}} |- | {{Dialogue|&cnOt EnOuGh SoUlFlOw!}} |} == Trivia == * The symbol for {{Stat|soulflow}}, U+2E0E ⸎ "EDITORIAL CORONIS", is displayed as a lined diamond on some fonts and systems and a square root symbol on other fonts and systems. * The probability to receive the message {{Red|"nOt EnOuGh SoUlFlOw!"}} instead of {{Red|"Not enough soulflow!"}} is {{Chance|2%|1|50}}. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.11.5|Added {{Stat|Soulflow}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Stats}}
